cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)

project(OpenGL-Solar-System)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Section generated by Gemini
# ---------------------------------------------------------

include(FetchContent)

set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

FetchContent_Declare(glfw
    GIT_REPOSITORY  https://github.com/glfw/glfw.git
    GIT_TAG         3.4
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glfw)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# glad.lib
# ---------------------------------------------------------

add_library(glad)
target_sources(glad
    PRIVATE
        lib/glad/src/glad.c
    PUBLIC
        FILE_SET HEADERS
        BASE_DIRS
            lib/glad/include
        FILES
            lib/glad/include/glad/glad.h
            lib/glad/include/KHR/khrplatform.h
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# main.exe
# ---------------------------------------------------------

add_executable(main)
target_sources(main
    PRIVATE
        src/main.cpp
)

target_compile_options(main PRIVATE -D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)

target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE glad glfw)
